args.title: Fix dedupe function to handle overlapping days in uploaded statements
args.body:
File: src/ingest/dedupe.ts

The dedupe function currently misses detecting duplicates when two statements with overlapping days are uploaded together in the same batch. This change proposes improving the dedupe logic to properly identify duplicates even if overlapping days occur in concurrently uploaded statements, ensuring the ledger does not record duplicated transactions from such uploads.
